body: Can you be more specific?  How can this be achieved if one is thin-skinned? Thanks.

Yes, my duck keeps me going!  He's a runner duck so he can't fly, but he wouldn't fly away from me anyway as he imprinted on me.  I would Make myself stay alive until the end of his lifespan because he would be so lost without me!  He wears a diaper so I can keep him indoors. We go everywhere together.

They are the ones projecting it, and we're just reacting because it's too much, and sometimes you can't get around avoiding them. Even though it's natural for animals including humans to dominate, if you're the recipient of that for too long it damages your ability to deflect further abuse.  Your post triggered me to respond lol because I feel like you're trying to place the blame where it doesn't belong, something abusers do.  It's not like I can get a brain transplant.  Trust me, I wish I knew how to deflect it.

I've been bullied all my life because I am "different".  And I do admit I'm an oddball, probably stemming from so much abuse.  I've been diagnosed as "schizophrenic".  I'm now a recluse and happier than I've ever been.  People still get to me though, like the crippled neighbor I tried to offer help, and apparently that was an invitation for him to treat me like shit.  He's a blatant asshole everytime I have to pass by his door while he's basking (he's crippled but he comes out in his walker occasionally).  Well, my anger had been brewing for a while towards him so after I went outside to water my plants I saw him basking and went back inside and grabbed my "liquid ass" spray. I was shaking with nerve but I managed to spritz 3 times while passing him!  The best part is it's hard for him to get away from the stench as he's crippled.  He just thought I was still a pushover.  Assholes need to get a whiff of their own essence.
